regulatory_history.title: In the Matter of X-Mode Social, Inc. and Outlogic, LLC (FTC Docket No. C-4802)
regulatory_history.notes: Announced 2024-01-09 and final 2024-04-11: the FTC's first settlement with a data broker over sensitive location data. It bans selling or sharing sensitive location data (sensitive places in the US) and requires deleting location data collected without consent unless it is deidentified. The order runs 20 years from its issuance. No admission of the charges.
